eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of relapsed and/or refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM) treated with at least 3 (Part 1), history of RRMM or at least 1 but not greater than 3 prior anti-myeloma treatment (PAMT) regimens (Part 2, Arms A, B, C, and D); history of quadruple class exposed RRMM having received BCMA TCE as the most recent line of therapy (Part 2, Arm E).
* Measurable multiple myeloma (MM) as per International Myeloma Working Group (IMWG).
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0-1.
* Adherence to contraception requirements.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior treatment with alnuctamab (Arm A), mezigdomide (Arms B and E), iberdomide (Arm C), elranatamab (Arm D) or BCMA-targeting therapy (Part 2 Arms A and D).
* Prior treatment with GPRC5D-targeting therapies as of Protocol Amendment 02 (Part 1 and Part 2).
* Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria apply.
